headline: EasyJet Pre-Tax Profit Collapses 96% as Fuel Costs Surge
summary: EasyJet reported a 96% collapse in pre-tax profit to £24m as soaring fuel prices triggered by the Iran war hit travel demand. The airline's boss stated he cannot rule out further job cuts and predicted rival carriers could fail.
why: Jet fuel represents a major variable operating expense for airlines, leaving profit margins highly sensitive to crude oil price shocks.

impacts.name: easyJet PLC
impacts.why: A 96% collapse in pre-tax profits directly damages the company's financial results and equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Higher fuel prices driven by geopolitical conflict sharply escalated operating costs, crushing airline profitability and sparking fears of insolvencies.
